summary:
Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct: 56 parts passed screening, using all 60 screens. 42 are MLP clusters of 64–512 units and 14 are attention-head groups of 4–6 heads. Every candidate came from a weight hypothesis and was checked by ablation, with attribution as a second line of evidence.

Three weight methods produced them:
- **Late layers (L20–L27):** rank down_proj columns by |cos| to a category's mean unembedding direction and by norm fraction in its unembedding subspace, penalised against other categories.
- **Head groups:** OV-circuit copy and successor scores (embedding → V → O → unembed), refined with attribution.
- **Mid layers (L8–L18):** grow attribution seed units to 64–128 units by summed gate/up/down weight similarity.

**Passed MLP clusters (42):**
- ordinal_word, covering every layer from L8 to L14 plus L17–L18, L20, L23–L24 and L26–L27:
  - L8 64 (.33), L9 64 (.73), L10 64 and 128 (.75/.76), L11 64 (.36), L13 64 (.46), L14 64 (.30), L17 64 (.34), L18 64 (.33)
  - L20 256 (.21)
  - L23 64 and 128 (.76/.77), L24 64, 256 and 512 (.91/.91/.92), L26 128 (.24), L27 160 (.56)
- number_to_word: L9 64 and 128 (.60/.64), L12 64 (.16), L17 128 (.17), L21 256 (.18), L23 256 (.28), L24 64 (.33), L25 64 and 256 (.42/.49), L27 256 (.48)
- month_successor: L25 128 and 256 (.42/.43), L27 64, 128 and 192 (.30/.33/.48)
- object_color: L23 128, L24 128 and 256, L25 128 and 256, L26 128 (.25–.38)
- weekday_successor: L23 64 and 128 (.63/.70), L25 64 and 128 (.31/.30)
- greek_letter_name: L22 208 (.34)

**Passed head groups (14):**
- ordinal_word: L9 [0,5,13,25] (.74), L14 [3,15,17,21] (.63), L16 [2,14,18,26] (.82), L19 [2,4,21,27] (.97), L21 [0,2,17,19] (.58), L25 [1,23,24,25] (.23), L26 [6,16,22,26] (.47)
- number_to_word: L16 [2,6,20,26] (.29), L25 [2,15,16,17] (.48), L25 [2,5,12,15,16,17] (.52)
- greek_letter_name: L24 [20,21,23,27] and [13,20,21,23,27] (.54)

**Findings:**
- Lexical skills run as depth-spanning pipelines. Mid-layer feature families can be found by weight-similarity growth from seeds; late layers hold distributed writer populations found by projection plus penalty; routing heads with successor OV circuits sit at many depths.
- L22–L23 hold a shared sequence/count hub.
- The L24 Greek copy heads are redundant across KV groups.
- The parity-attributed L27 units are a/an and vowel-onset writers, not parity parts.

**What didn't work:**
- Parity, product_sign, code, multilingual, facts and math: no selective parts. Whole blocks and L0 heads are non-selective.
- New skills couldn't be defined because the custom-skill cap was reached.
